indicator_name: New tangible fixed assets put into operation
description: Ввод в действие новых основных средств
methodology: Billion KZT, new fixed assets put into operation during the year. Tangible fixed assets («Основные средства», Taldau term 455728, intangibles excluded) of all enterprises, form 11, national, from 2000. Historical-cost book values incl. revaluations -- not a volume measure. Taldau 703205.
